'''Orilltha''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] who served as an instructor at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] alongside [[Borthis]], [[Hezzoran]], [[Kas'im]], [[Shenayag]], and [[Qordis]].
